name: Thiamylal
summary: Thiamylal (Surital) is a barbiturate derivative invented in the 1950s. It has sedative, anticonvulsant, and hypnotic effects, and is used as a strong but short acting sedative. Thiamylal is still in current use, primarily for induction in surgical anaesthesia or as an anticonvulsant to counteract side effects from other anaesthetics. It is the thiobarbiturate analogue of secobarbital.

uses.text: It has sedative, anticonvulsant, and hypnotic effects, and is used as a strong but short acting sedative.

sideEffects.en: It can cause low blood pressure and slowed or stopped breathing, which is why it is used only under medical supervision. As a barbiturate, it can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, confusion and dependence. Overdose can stop breathing and is often fatal, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause dangerous withdrawal with seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成血壓過低以及呼吸變慢或停止，因此只在醫療監護下使用。作為巴比妥類藥物，它可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、意識混亂與依賴。過量可能使呼吸停止，往往致命；長期使用後突然停藥可能出現危險的戒斷反應，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成血压过低以及呼吸变慢或停止，因此只在医疗监护下使用。作为巴比妥类药物，它可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、意识混乱与依赖。过量可能使呼吸停止，往往致命；长期使用后突然停药可能出现危险的戒断反应，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Thiamylal is the sulphur version of the barbiturate secobarbital: one oxygen atom is replaced by sulphur, which makes it act fast enough to be used to start anaesthesia.
fact.zh: Thiamylal是巴比妥類藥物司可巴比妥的含硫版本：把一個氧原子換成硫原子，使它作用快到足以用來誘導麻醉。
fact.zhHans: Thiamylal是巴比妥类药物司可巴比妥的含硫版本：把一个氧原子换成硫原子，使它作用快到足以用来诱导麻醉。
